tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa khyer bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu stobs kun/ /rab bsdus rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ /rab zab dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /rab mchog bla ma nag por 'dud/ /gang de bsten cing sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang yang rgya bod mkhas grub gzhung / /gang gis nyams su len thabs pas/ /gang 'dir bskang ba'i rnam gzhag bshad/ /'dir dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa khyer bde don tshang rgyal ba dges pa'i mchod rdzas su bskrun pa la/ brgyad/ bcu bzhi/ nyer gsum/ nyer dgu sogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can rnams la bla ma gong ma'i thugs rten sogs 'di'i bris 'bur gyi sku bzhugs pa'i drung stegs kyi khar ras sogs kyis bkab steng 'bru sna tshogs bkram pa'i gzhi la thod pa dum bu gsum pa'am/ lcags sder ram zangs mkhar ba/ rdza sogs kyi sder ma'am stegs gtsang ba'i khar/ nas nag rjen btags kyi phud phye/ chang / khrag mar khu/ bum rdzas nyer lnga/ bdud rtsi ril phye dang lhan cig sbrus pa'i dam rdzas rgyan ldan gyi gtor ma gru gsum zur rtse mi rno ba'i ldebs gsum la dbus nag mtha' dmar gyi rtsi byugs mtheb kyu bcad kham phyir bstan brgya rtsa gtor ma'i phyed tsam nub pa'i dkyil dang rtser mar dkar gyi sgor rgyan/ dbus bu ram ma bsgar ba leb sbyar dkyil sha ril mtheb tog tsam brgyan pa/ rtse sgrom mdzad na dbus su thod khrag gaṇ+ḍi/ gri gug rdo rje'i yu ba can rnams brtsegs pa'i mthar me ri mar tshon gser shog sogs gang mdzes/ khyung / bya/ rta/ g.yag khyi/ lug mi rnams nag po'i gzugs btsugs pa/ smyug rgod tshigs gsum par rgod sgro gsum mam bzhi bskyon zhing gri lcags kyi mde'u zur gsum pa glang dmar rgyus pas bsdams pa/

dung gi stong kha mtshal dmar gyis byugs pa'i mgul du dar nag btsugs drung mchod bya'i g.yon nas 'go bzung ba'i thod pa sogs kyi snod du khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog gzugs/ rus rkang klad pa/ gu gul spos/ zhun chen bsreg pa'i mar nag sgron me'i sdong bu/ ro ras/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus zhal zas zhes smad sum gcig zlum po/ stod gsum gnyis zur gsum dbal can khrag gis byug shing / me ris brgyan pa/ de'i phyir mchod 'go gong bzhin nas/ chu gnyis/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams zhi mchod/ sgrub po'i drung rang gi g.yon nas g.yas su/ nang mchod/ dril bu/ rdo rje/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas rnams dang / gzhan yang rnga rol dung dkar/ rkang gling / phud skyems/ gu gul/ g.yab dar/ tshogs rdzas sogs ci 'byor bshams la/ thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ 'gro rnams sgrol 'dod bsam pa yis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi dkyus 'gre/ oṃ shu n+yā tā dzña na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang / /bdud bzhi brtsegs steng rang nyid ni/ /dgyes rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug /zhabs bzhi bdag med yum dang rol/ /phyag mtshan rgyan dang bzhugs stabs sogs/ /mtshan nyid kun rdzogs thugs kar nyir/ /hūm̐ yig sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ci nus ljags bzlas ni bdag bskyed do/ /mchod gtor bsang ba ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /khro tshogs ljang gu g.yas g.yon gyis/ /sna tshogs rdo rje des mtshan dril/ /thogs pa me 'od dang bcas spros/ /mchod gtor bgegs kun bskrad par gyur/

/zhes dang / rdo rje'i rtse nang mchod nas mchod gtor rnams la 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ zhes pa mchod gtor rnams gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa ma dag pa sbyong ba la zer/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa rnams/ /a las dum gsum thod pa ni/ /phyi dkar nang dmar dpral mdun bstan/ /yangs shing rgya cher hūm̐ zhu las/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang / /rol mo'i rnam pa zhi ba'i rdzas/ /gzhan yang thod pa de lta'i nang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag mtsho dang / /mig dang rna ba sna lce snying / /rus rkang klad tshil bsregs pa'i dud/ /rkang til mar khu ro ras sdong / /mkhris pa sman sna'i dri chab dang / /sha khrag rus spungs zhal zas rngam/ /rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i sgras/ /gzhan yang rlung me thod sgyed steng / /thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang / /ba lang khyi rta glang chen mi'i/ /sha dang dri chen khrag zhu ba/ /klad pa dri chu bdud rtsi lnga/ /bh+rūṃ oṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ yig ste/ /ye shes lnga ngos rlung me yis/ /bskyod pas ro gcig bdud rtsi ni/ /rnam pa sha khrag rus las grub/ /dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor mar gyur/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ma hā pañtsa in+d+ra gu h+ya puṣ+pe/ ma hā me da gu h+ya dhu pe/ ma hā madhu ra gu h+ye ā lo ke ma hā ba su ru dhi ra gu h+ya gan+dhe/ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta bhu dza tha pi pa tha ma hā shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhi drag gi mchod pa'i phyag rgya spyi 'gre mchod pa byin brlabs/ phyag g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams rim bzhin gtor mar bsten nas 'chab ba dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin brlabs/

rang nyid kyai yi rdo rje'i mdun/ /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad dbus su/ /paṃ pad raṃ nyi mi ro'i steng / /hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ mtshan las/ /'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'dus/ /yongs gyur dpal ldan rdo rje che/ /nag po chen po gur gyi mgon/ /che zhing cher 'bar sku mdog nag /phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag ni/ /thugs kar steng 'og dbus gaṇ+ḍi/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum mche gtsigs zhal/ /ljags 'dril rngams sgra khrag rgyun 'dzag /sma smin dbu skra dmar ser brdzes/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /thod rlon khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i phreng / /rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul gyis brgyan/ /stag sham dar gyi lhab lhub can/ /mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /ro gdan la 'gying g.yas g.yon rgyab/ /mdun steng rnams su bya khyi nag /ce spyang sngo dang mi nag tshogs/ /khyung chen rigs lnga'i 'phro 'du can/ /ye shes me 'bar dbus bzhugs kyi/ /dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /dkar dmar mthing mtshan rang nyid kyi/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs gyur/ /gu gul tshil chen sogs kyi dud pa/ rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar sogs dang bcas rol mos bying dbab/ gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes ni/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i gzugs/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig can/ /mgon po 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bzhugs/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma sūr+ya sha truṃ bait+ta li ā pa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang / rdor thal kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ka a pash+tsi ma/ ma kā la a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na tra ya ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ yi ti pra tri dzña/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/

pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tshar gsum sogs kyis gtor ma bsngo bar gnang nas gong bzhin mchod sngags mtheb srin nang mchod 'bul ba'i stangs ka dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po che/ /lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor bcas mchod/ /bstan 'gro rnal 'byor bar chad srung / /bsam kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces 'phrin bcol dang / bskang ba dngos ni/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ ma dag snod bcud snang srid ji snyed pa/ /dag pa rab 'byams mchod yon zhabs bsil dang / /me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri dang zas/ /rol mo rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags ri gling nyi zla sogs/ /rin chen 'bru sna dar gos sman la sogs/ /ngo mtshar phyi yi bskang rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /ma hā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐ gsang chen zab mo'i rang bzhin dur khrod gnas/ /'jigs rung drag po'i gzhal yas chen po'i nang / /dam nyams phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi/ /thod snod yangs par de yi khrag rgyun 'khyil/ /dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen dud sprin dang / /zhun chen sgron me mkhris chen sman sna'i dri/ /sha rus bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan/ /rkang gling thod lnga 'jigs rung sna tshogs sgra/ /g.yang gzhi'i bla bre glo snying rgyu ma'i 'phan/ /gdug can gcan gzan shun pa sbrul gdug phreng / /rab gsang rus pa'i rgyan drug dam tshig rdzas/ /ro dum ro skra'i rnga yab zhwa gos l+h+wam/ /mig sman mdog sogs nang gi mchod rdzas kyis/ /ma hā kā lā 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐ khyad par rmad byung rang bzhin lhan skyes rdzas/ /tshad ldan bde skyong dam rdzas bcud kyis phyur/ /bhan+dha lcang lo sbyor sgrol rak+tas gang / /dug gsum gtor snod dmar chen gtor ma rngams/ /dpa' bo g.yul bsad gri snying rdzas 'khor can/ /pho rgyud sprin ltar 'tshubs pa'i rnga yab nag

/mo rgyud rlung dmar 'du ba'i nal bu'i gsob/ /gsang mdos pad tshal sde brgyad bung ba'i gsob/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha bdud sde'i srog gi gshed/ /phyi rten bya nag la sogs sprul pa'i 'khor/ /nang rten sku gsung thugs kyi rnam rol can/ /gsang rten rgyud gsum dreg pa'i srog gi bcud/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sogs/ /phul byung bstan srung thun mong min pa'i rdzas/ /ma hā kā lā 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐/ thog med dus nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /ma rig las nyon las byung bcas rang sdig /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs 'gal thar pa'i gegs/ /ci mchis mkha' mnyam sdig dang lhan cig bshags/ /hūm̐/ mgon khyod thugs dam gsang ba bskul ba'i phyir/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ yig sngags phreng bcas/ /bdag nyid dgyes pa rdo rje'i 'od kyis bskul/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbyar dam da dgongs shig /ces rnga rol bzhag nas g.yul bsad dung chen kyis phreng ba gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu dgu sgril phreng thag can mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs/ grangs bzung bcu shad can gyi byin brlabs phyag g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi sbyor bas grangs la thog mar/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i yig brgya ci rigs/ de nas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs gong bzhin ci rigs/ de nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na/ sogs gong bzhin te/ nye snying bdun ma/ snying po bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa sngags sha sa na rnams las rgyun du nye snying gtso bor mdzad/ drag las la shā sa na gtso bor mdzad cing / de yang byad ma kha kha sogs 'dogs can du mdzod/ de ltar ljags bzlas grub pa dang / rnga rol sogs bcas/ bskul bzlog ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs sprul srung dbang khyod nyid kyis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bdag sogs sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs kun sol/

/lung rtogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs kun spel/ /snod bcud phun tshogs 'dod kun dbang du bsdus/ /bstan 'gror gnod kun da lta nyid du sgrol/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub lhun grub mdzod/ /hūm̐ bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten la gnod pa'i/ /gzugs can dam nyams dgra bo'i ngan g.yo dang / /gzugs med len chags bgegs kyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /snod bcud ma rungs byed rnams de nyid la/ /myur du bzlog sgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ srin po'i phun tshogs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /zhi ba'i dge mtshan spang rtogs mthar phyin stsol/ /mkhas grub gnyan gcig rdo rje nag po che/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi mthu chen mnga' gsol lo/ /hūm̐ mi 'gyur mthing mdog chos kun ro gcig zhal/ /bde gnyis phyag dang gzung 'dzin mtha' gnon zhabs/ /mchog thun rab stsol rngams brjid cha lugs can/ /yon tan dpag med gur gyi mgon por bstod/ /de nas gtor ma la nyin mo yin na spos rengs dang / srod tho rangs sogs yin na dpal 'bar btsugs/ phud chang dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dam can dbang phyug nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i rnam 'phrul gtor ma che/ /bza' bca' ldangs myang btung ba khyad par rdzas/ /ri dang rgya mtsho'i rnams rol 'di bzhes la/ /bla ma'i sku tshe bsring dang thub bstan spel/ /de 'dzin bshad sgrub sde skyongs 'jig rten la/ /gnas srungs logs spel bdag ltos bcas kun la/ /rtag tu 'go zhing 'tshes pa'i brtse gdung mdzod/ /ces dang / drag rol bcas gtor ma thog kha dang ri gtsang sogs su khyer la phud chang 'thor ba sngon 'gro'i sum gnyis yar phul/ gsum gcig mar zhu ba man ngag tu mdzad do/ /de nas/ hūm̐ gang yang bdag blo'i skyon gyur pa'i/ /lhag chad nor 'khrul bag med bshags/ /mdun bzhugs mgon po rang la thim/ /rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /dge des gnas skabs don kun 'grub/

/mthar thug nag po che thob shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum bkra shis kyi/ /dga' char dbyangs snyan deng 'dir byon/ /zhes brjod la grol lo/ zhes shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rin po che'i gangs ljongs skye dgu'i mgon gcig tu chos rgyal lo paṇa thugs rje can rnams kyis 'dzugs par mdzad kyang / glang dar mas mtshan tsam mi 'byung bar byas mod/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang 'gro 'di'i legs byas las/ slar yang skyes chen dam pa rnams nas bstan pa'i nyams gso gnang bar phyi dar du grags pa'i nang tshan/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por rjes su bzung pas sa drug gi rtogs pa chen por gyur pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug birawa pa'i brgyud 'dzin lo chen shākya ye shes kyi slob brgyud/ 'od gsal lha dang 'khon ston sa skya pa ste mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi gdung rabs las mchog gyur dkar po rnam gsum/ chos rje khu dbon rnams la rje btsun gong ma rnam lngar grags pa'i bka' srol la sa lugs zhes grags par/ dus phyis 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bstan sku phreng bdun phebs sogs kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mtshan 'chang rnams nas dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod stsal ba ltar/ deng 'dir yang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan rigs tha shal 'du shes gsum pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes ming snyan don la mi gnas pa bdag la chos skyong chen po 'di'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rnam gzhag gong zhus bzhin bla ma gong mas mdzad zin yod na smos med dang / de min 'di 'dra zhig rtsom zhes bka'i cod paṇa gtsug gi rgyan du bkod de dad gus chen pos 'gal 'khrul med khul du gsar rtsom zhus kyang thog med las nyon mongs dbang che bas nyes tshogs ci mchis bshags 'bul dang bcas legs pa'i cha 'dra mchis na kun mkhyen bla ma dges pa'i mchod rdzas su gyur nas bdag sogs gdul bya rnams la grub gnyis dga' ston gyi 'khor ba mtha' can gyi rgyur gyur cig/
//yi ge pa'ang rmongs rgan rang nas saṃ bu ṭar bkod do// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
